value_flow.calculation: getDamage uses combatTalentMindDamage; info damDesc emits the damage parameter. Radius from getTalentRadius; center knockback=2.
value_flow.actual_arguments: action filters reactionToward < 0, computes localDamage but calls forceHit with original damage and max(0,knockback-distance).
value_flow.consumer: forceHit mindCrit and PHYSICAL projector consume original damage; power only goes to particles; DAZED applied only to collected enemies.

value_flow.actual_arguments: On hit and cut eligibility, CUT receives power=getBleedDamage and duration=5, with no multiplication by attack damage and no division by five.
